description: Unique row identifier in this extract. It identifies a row, not a separate statistical measure of crime.
range_or_values: 1 to 82,746, one distinct value on every row.

description: Police occurrence identifier (GO number). The file is published at offence level, so one identifier can appear on more than one row.
range_or_values: 74,604 distinct identifiers. Example: GO-20141262837. 8,142 additional rows reuse an identifier.

description: Date the offence was reported. The publisher stores this timestamp in UTC. The clock time is midnight Eastern, not the hour the report was taken.
range_or_values: 4,656 distinct values, from 2014-01-01 to 2026-09-30. Clock time is only 4:00:00 AM (55,135 rows), 5:00:00 AM (27,611 rows).

description: Date the offence occurred, also stored in UTC with the same midnight convention. A few rows contain a date even though the occurrence year, month, and day fields are blank.
range_or_values: 4,710 distinct values, from 1969-06-06 to 2026-09-30. Clock time is only 4:00:00 AM (55,090 rows), 5:00:00 AM (27,656 rows). Non-null OCC_YEAR runs from 2000 to 2026.

description: Four-digit year of the report date.
range_or_values: 2014 to 2026 (13 years). 2026 is partial: 5,699 rows, January through September.

description: Month name of the report date.
range_or_values: All 12 month names. Most rows: September (7,391). Fewest rows: February (5,962).

description: Day of the month of the report date.
Day of the year of the report date. Leap years use 366.
Weekday name of the report date. Each name is padded with spaces to a width of 10 characters.
range_or_values: Seven weekday names, each padded to 10 characters: 'Friday    ', 'Monday    ', 'Saturday  ', 'Sunday    ', 'Thursday  ', 'Tuesday   ', 'Wednesday '. Most rows: Thursday (12,779). Fewest rows: Sunday (9,357).

description: Hour the offence was reported, on a 0–23 clock. This is the reporting hour; it is separate from the clock time stored on REPORT_DATE.
range_or_values: 0 to 23. Mean 11.46, median 10, most frequent hour 7 (7,971 rows).

description: Year the offence occurred. Pandas stores it as a float because six rows are blank. The business type is a year.
range_or_values: 2000 to 2026 on 82,740 non-null rows (22 distinct years). Mean 2021.13. Six rows are blank.

description: Month name of the occurrence date. Blank on the same six rows as OCC_YEAR.
range_or_values: All 12 month names on non-null rows. Most rows: September (7,304). Six rows are blank.

description: Day of the month of the occurrence. Stored as a float because those six rows are blank.
range_or_values: 1 to 31. Mean 15.64. Six rows are blank.

description: Day of the year of the occurrence. Stored as a float because those six rows are blank.
range_or_values: 1 to 366. Mean 184.17. Six rows are blank.

description: Weekday name of the occurrence. Names are space-padded to 10 characters, and six rows are blank.
range_or_values: Same seven space-padded weekday names as REPORT_DOW. Six rows are blank.

description: Hour the offence occurred, on a 0–23 clock. This field is filled even on rows whose occurrence date components are blank.
range_or_values: 0 to 23. Mean 13.76, median 16, most frequent hour 22 (7,288 rows).

description: Toronto Police division recorded for the occurrence. The value NSA means the row was not assigned to a division.
range_or_values: 18 labels: D11, D12, D13, D14, D22, D23, D31, D32, D33, D41, D42, D43, D51, D52, D53, D54, D55, and NSA. Most rows: D23 (11,105). Fewest division: D54 (346). NSA: 414.

description: Detailed place where the offence occurred, such as a parking lot, a house, or a street.
range_or_values: 42 categories, plus 18 blank rows. Most common: Parking Lots (Apt., Commercial Or Non-Commercial) (30,164); Single Home, House (Attach Garage, Cottage, Mobile) (24,896); Streets, Roads, Highways (Bicycle Path, Private Road) (15,064). The full list is in results/location_type_counts.csv.

description: Grouped premises category for the location (Outside, House, Commercial, Apartment, Other, Transit, or Educational).
range_or_values: Outside (45,439); House (24,896); Commercial (6,773); Apartment (2,790); Other (2,459); Transit (283); Educational (106).

description: Statistics Canada Uniform Crime Reporting code. Every row in this extract is theft of a motor vehicle.
range_or_values: 2135 on every row.

description: Extension of the UCR code. It is constant in this extract.
range_or_values: 210 on every row.

description: Offence name published with the UCR code.
range_or_values: Theft Of Motor Vehicle on every row.

description: Community Safety Indicator category used by Toronto Police.
range_or_values: Auto Theft on every row.

description: Neighbourhood code from the City of Toronto 158-area geography. Codes are stored as text and include NSA.
range_or_values: 159 distinct text codes, including NSA. Example: 159.

description: Neighbourhood name under the 158-area geography, with the area number in parentheses. NSA means the row was not assigned to a neighbourhood.
range_or_values: 159 labels, including NSA (931 rows). Highest raw count: West Humber-Clairville (1) (6,279 rows).

description: Neighbourhood code from the older 140-area geography. Some codes are zero-padded, and NSA is included.
range_or_values: 141 distinct text codes, including NSA. Example of zero-padding: 014.

description: Neighbourhood name under the 140-area geography, including NSA.
range_or_values: 141 labels, including NSA. Example: Islington-City Centre West (14).

description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees. Published points are offset to the nearest intersection. A value of 0 is a placeholder, not a Toronto location.
range_or_values: Valid values -79.639 to -79.122. 891 rows are 0.

description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees. The same intersection offset and zero-value placeholder apply.
range_or_values: Valid values 43.587 to 43.853. The same 891 rows are 0.

description: Web Mercator easting in metres, corresponding to LONG_WGS84. Placeholder rows are 0.
range_or_values: Valid values -8,865,400 to -8,807,826 metres. The same 891 rows are 0.

description: Web Mercator northing in metres, corresponding to LAT_WGS84. Placeholder rows are 0.
range_or_values: Valid values 5,401,809 to 5,442,747 metres. The same 891 rows are 0.
